title: Enrollment and Coverage Period of Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
### Clause 1 — Sale and enrollment

A Vehicle Service Contract is sold only at contract signing, on a vehicle within the plan's entry limits for vehicle age and odometer that is not used commercially, for the plan's retail price financed in the retail installment contract.

### Clause 2 — Coverage period

Coverage runs from the enrollment date for the plan's term in months and from the odometer at sale for the plan's coverage mileage, ending at whichever limit comes first; claims are adjudicated and paid by DriveSure Administrative Services, LLC, the administrator.

### Clause 3 — The enrollment record

When the borrower buys the service contract at signing and its price is financed, one service contract record is opened for the borrower, tied to the retail installment contract financing it, and showing:

| Item on the record | What it holds |
|---|---|
| Coverage plan | the DriveSure plan bought |
| Enrollment date | the contract date |
| Price financed | the price of the service contract financed |
| Odometer at sale | the odometer at enrollment |
| Expiration date | the enrollment date plus the plan's term in months |
| Expiration odometer | the odometer at sale plus the plan's coverage mileage |
| Net price | set to the price financed |

The contract starts in force (status active).

### Conditions of sale at a glance

| Condition | Met when |
|---|---|
| Timing | the sale is made at contract signing |
| Vehicle age | within the plan's age limit |
| Odometer at sale | within the plan's odometer limit |
| Use | the vehicle is not used commercially |
| Price | the plan's retail price, financed in the retail installment contract |

### Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

A plan with a 36-month term and 36000 coverage miles, enrolled on a contract dated 10 April with 41000 miles on the odometer, shows an expiration date 36 months after 10 April and an expiration odometer of 77000 miles (41000 plus 36000). If the vehicle reaches 77000 miles before the expiration date, coverage ends at 77000 miles; if the expiration date arrives first, coverage ends on that date.
